text: Of David (beloved). 1 I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul (You emboldened me with strength in my soul).
All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD {YHWH}, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
They will sing of the ways of the LORD {YHWH}, for the glory of the LORD is great.
Though the LORD {YHWH} is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
The LORD {YHWH} will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever—do not abandon the works of Your hands.
